en: The image is a vintage postcard featuring an illustrated dump truck with two people standing beside it. The background includes a stylized map and a steering wheel, emphasizing the theme of automobiles. The right side prominently displays the text '37. INTERNATIONALE AUTOMOBIL-AUSSTELLUNG Zettelmeyer in Frankfurt'. The left side lists various exhibition halls and the types of vehicles or parts found in each, written in German. The overall design suggests it is a promotional postcard for an automotive exhibition.
